name: confidence-scored-pattern-detection
description: Add confidence scores to pattern detection to reduce false positives and identify reliable training patterns
steps: Define confidence calculation function (0.0-1.0) based on keyword strength, context, specificity
Set confidence threshold (e.g., ≥0.3) for pattern inclusion
Categorize into levels: high (≥0.7), medium (0.5-0.7), low (<0.5)
Generate statistics: avg confidence, distribution per pattern type
Filter to reliable patterns (≥0.5) for training data
Report recommendations: which patterns are trustworthy
triggers: high false positive rate in pattern detection
need to identify reliable patterns for training
shadow analysis producing too much noise
examples: 'What is machine learning' → explain_requests @ 0.60 (medium, review before training)
